extrahop_revealx_raw.dataset_description: ExtraHop Reveal(x) is a network detection and response (NDR) platform that detects threats in network traffic.

id.field_description: The unique ID ExtraHop assigns to the detection.

end_time.field_description: The time the detection activity ended, in epoch milliseconds.

mod_time.field_description: The time the detection was last modified, in epoch milliseconds.

risk_score.field_description: The risk score ExtraHop assigns to the detection.

start_time.field_description: The time the detection activity started, in epoch milliseconds.

create_time.field_description: The time the detection was created in the ExtraHop system.

recommended.field_description: Indicates whether ExtraHop recommends the detection.

update_time.field_description: The time the detection was last updated, in epoch milliseconds.

appliance_id.field_description: The ID of the ExtraHop sensor or appliance that generated the detection.

is_user_created.field_description: Indicates whether a user created the ExtraHop detection.

url.field_description: The URL associated with the ExtraHop detection.

type.field_description: The event type of the ExtraHop record.

title.field_description: The display title of the ExtraHop detection.

status.field_description: The current triage status of the detection in ExtraHop.

assignee.field_description: The user the detection is assigned to for investigation.

ticket_id.field_description: The ID of the ticket associated with the detection.

categories.field_description: The list of categories the detection belongs to.

properties.field_description: The detection-specific properties of the ExtraHop detection.

resolution.field_description: The resolution recorded for the detection when it was closed.

description.field_description: The description of the threat the detection identifies.

participants.field_description: The devices and other objects involved in the detection.

mitre_tactics.field_description: The MITRE ATT&CK tactics associated with the detection.

mitre_techniques.field_description: The MITRE ATT&CK techniques associated with the detection.

recommended_factors.field_description: The list of factors behind ExtraHop's recommendation of the detection.
